mentions.name: SceneDraw
mentions.description: A free web app for managing multiple Excalidraw diagrams. Users can keep many scenes, and each scene is backed by a .excalidraw file that is synced to Google Drive, keeping diagrams organized and safe from loss.
mentions.problem: Excalidraw users lacked a simple solution to manage different diagrams and worried about losing them.
mentions.source_excerpt: So I built https://scenedraw.app/ to solve this. This is free. You can keep multiple scenes. Each scene is backed by a .excalidraw file which is synced in your google drive.
